from math import gcd

x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
i = 1
A = 0
B = 1
k = 0

while i <= n:
    if i == 1:
        A = k
        B = i
    k = x * i // y
    j = 0
    while j <= 10:
        val = k + j
        mn1 = abs(x * i - y * val) * y * B
        mn2 = abs(x * B - y * A) * y * i
        if mn1 < mn2:
            A = val
            B = i
        j += 1
    i += 1

g = gcd(A, B)
print(f"{A // g}/{B // g}")
